title: Floe normalized 2D electronics library record
description: One normalized symbol, footprint or component record produced by floe_electronics.normalizers.normalize(). This is an exchange/catalog schema for a future native adapter; it is not a native runtime package format. All geometry is in millimeters. 3D models are referenced as metadata only and never included as bytes.

id.description: Opaque stable record id: floe:electronics:<source>:<kind>:<library-slug>:<name-slug>~<discriminator>. The discriminator is the intrinsic LibrePCB UUID where present, otherwise a stable digest of the exact (source path, exact unsanitized element name) identity. Slug segments are readable only; the discriminator makes ids collision-free and independent of file/document iteration order, so ids do not shift when new source files or duplicate names are inserted. Exact duplicate source identities are flagged duplicate-source-identity or duplicate-id and remain reviewRequired.

kind.description: LibrePCB devices are emitted as component records with properties.role == 'device'.

identifiers.description: Source identities (KiCad symbol/footprint name, LibrePCB UUID).

status.description: converted = fully normalized known content; reviewRequired = conversion succeeded but contains features needing review; unsupported = not usable as-is (parse failure, invalid root, cyclic/unresolved inheritance).

issues.description: Machine-readable issue codes, e.g. parse-error:..., unresolved-dependency:<role>:<uuid>, cyclic-inheritance, duplicate-id, unhandled-tag, custom-pad-geometry.

properties.description: Source metadata (properties, flags, units count, device role).

dependencies.description: Source dependency identities by role (extends, categories, symbols, components, packages, signals, packagePads, padstacks).

references.description: Structured cross-entity references copied from the source (LibrePCB symbol variants/gates, device pin-pad map).

modelReferences.description: 3D model references only; no model bytes are ever included.

pins.description: Symbol pins / component signals with positionMm, rotationDeg, lengthMm and source identity.

pads.description: Footprint pads with positionMm, rotationDeg, sizeMm, layers, drill, net and preserved custom geometry.

footprints.description: LibrePCB package footprints (pads, graphics, model references).

graphics.description: Semantic 2D graphics (lines, rects, circles, arcs, polylines, bezier curves, text).

unhandled.description: Verbatim JSON of source nodes this normalizer does not semantically decode; never dropped.

raw.description: Verbatim JSON of the complete source expression tree for the record's source element.

path.description: Path relative to the source checkout root, POSIX separators.

sha256.description: SHA-256 of the exact original source file bytes.

modelReference.description: Metadata-only 3D model reference. Offsets/scales/rotations are retained exactly as found in the source and are not unit-converted.
